facts.business: Dutron Polymers Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in the manufacturing of polymers and related products.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters: (1) Management dispute among key managerial personnel/shareholders pending before NCLT Ahmedabad regarding control and oppression/mismanagement; (2) Significant related party transactions including waste/scrap purchases from group companies with allegations before NCLT, RoC (dismissed), and SEBI (under enquiry) regarding arm's length pricing and completeness of disclosures.

key_risks: Ongoing management disputes among promoters/shareholders pending before NCLT affecting governance and financial decision-making
Regulatory scrutiny of related party transactions (SEBI enquiry, NCLT allegations) regarding arm's length pricing and completeness
Potential impact on going concern assumption and asset impairment due to governance disputes
facts.related_party_note: Significant related party transactions including purchases, sales, services and loans disclosed in Note No. 34. Allegations raised regarding waste/scrap purchases from group companies. Transactions subject to Audit Committee and shareholder approvals under Section 188 and SEBI LODR. Ongoing SEBI enquiry and NCLT proceedings regarding certain transactions.
